description: Secure your child’s future with the first ever 2-in-1 education and investment plan. Your child’s dreams are limitless—make sure their education is, too! With a Soma Sure Lite Education Plan, you’re not just saving for school fees; you’re building a secure financial future that grows with them. This plan offers you the perfect blend of protection, savings, and investment growth, ensuring your child gets the best education while you enjoy peace of mind. About Soma Sure Lite Education Plan Soma Sure Lite Education Plan is an investment-linked education policy that enables you, as a parent or guardian, to save towards your child’s education by investing in a fund while enjoying insurance protection. With Kes 1,000 you can start the journey of securing your child’s future..
premium_notes: Quote-based — no public price table. Request a callback or download the product brochure.
key_benefits: Flexibility: In addition to your regular premium deposits, this plan allows you to make additional contributions of any amount helping you grow your education fund faster.
Protection: In the unfortunate event of your demise, we will continue to pay your outstanding premiums so that the final payouts remain as you had intended, thus securing your child’s education.
Tax relief: If you sign up for a policy with a duration of 10 years and above, you get to enjoy a tax relief of 15% of your contribution(s) subject to a maximum amount of Kes. 60,000 per annum.
Partial and full withdrawals: In case of an emergency, you can access your funds 30 days after the policy's start date.
Permanent and Total Disability (PTD) Benefit: You will receive a lumpsum payment in the event of permanent and total disability.

Critical Illness Benefit: You will receive a lumpsum payment on the first diagnosis of a critical illness to assist you to seek medical care locally or abroad and to help you adjust to lifestyle changes.
Family Income Benefit: Your beneficiary will receive a regular monthly income for a specified benefit payment term in the event of death due to accidental or non-accidental causes.
Funeral Expense Benefit: Your beneficiary will receive a lumpsum payment in the event of death.
Have a valid national identification card or Kenyan passport or Alien ID.
Minimum age of entry of 18 years.
Maximum age of entry of 60 years.
Any other eligibility criteria shall be determined based on underwriting guidelines from time to time.
Complete the application form.
Attach the following documentation:
ID copy
PIN certificate
Payment mode for future payments
First payment
You can get a medical checkup by a doctor from our panel at our cost (recommended)
how_to_apply: Request a callback online via the product page. Britam also available on WhatsApp: +254705100100.

For policies lasting more than 10 years, you are entitled to a tax relief of up to 15% of the premium paid and the full amount payable at the end of the policy is tax free.
You are entitled to premium discounts each time you make a payment of KES 5,000 and above. This means a lower premium for the same amount of cover.
In case you miss a payment, you have until 60 days to pay your arrears and proceed with your policy as normal.
Super E Plus allows you to make your other investment dreams a reality in addition to investing in yours or your children’s education.
It provides 6 bonuses totalling 130% of the sum assured and a lump sum of 100% of the sum assured at the end of the term.
You can also take a loan of up to 80% of the value of your policy. Imagine how much further your investments could be with access to such capital.
For policies lasting more than 10 years, you are entitled to a tax relief of up to 15% of the premium paid, and the full amount payable at the end of the policy is tax free.
Super E Plus comes with a life insurance policy equal to the sum assured.
In the event you contract any critical illness covered by the policy for example cancer, stroke or a heart attack, Britam pays 50% of the sum assured immediately.
You will be exempted from paying all future premiums. Bonuses and lump sum payments will also be paid when they fall due.
If the insured passes on accidentally, Britam pays 100% of the sum assured and waives all the other premiums required as Britam makes the payments for you.
Bonuses and lump sum payments will also be paid when they fall due.
If you are unable to pay the premiums due to a disability, accident or illness, all the future premiums will be paid by Britam.
